page.layout: One page of text, single column, centred display lines and italic verse with a drop initial; no margin notes. Running head absent. Page number at top centre; ornament and signature mark at foot.

main_text.head: Nobiliss. atque Excellentiss. Viro, JOHANNI JONSTONO, Fama scriptisque per Orbem Celeberrimo, Polyhistora evulganti.

p.i: Ultratus aether, aetheris blandi incola Cohors volucrum, queque per saltus meant Armenta, torvo quisque raucatu fremit Segrex, & expers legis & freni furor, Scrutata ponti cerula, & vastis tumens Aequor procellis, omne squammigerum genus, Te fante nobis, Magne Jonstoni, patet. Quin ipsa Chloris munere illustris Tuo Sacrum perenni flore pratexit caput. Quid reflat ergo? Temporum flatus vices, Quae digna laude struxit Adamidum labos, Aut quae pudendi scelerís affatu rea Erravit aetas, turpis errati memor; Tot seculorum cenfor & Prefles dabit. Subscribe Fama: Dia Jonstoni Manus Expinxit Orbem: Vir Homo Tantum Audeat. Expinget Aevum: Solus Hoc Ausit, Scio, (Vir Magne) Solus Audet, Ast Per Te, Deus.

main_text.head: ANDREAS GRYPHIUS, Illust. & Generosis. Ordinum Ducat. Glogov, Syndicus.

page.notes: Initial U of the first verse is a drop capital; the verse is set in italic throughout. Some letters in the verse are worn and doubtful, notably in "squammigerum" and "Prefles". Ornamental marks at the foot are not transcribed.
